annotations.title: 12-Station Tool Turret Assembly
annotations.overview: The 12-Station Tool Turret Assembly is the machine’s indexed tool carrier. It combines the circular VDI30 turret head, supporting module, slide carriage, encoder feedback hardware, and two heavy-duty electrical connector assemblies.
annotations.function: It rotates a selected station toward the cutting position and supports the tool holders while the carriage locates the turret relative to the work area. No indexing accuracy or tooling rating is inferred.
annotations.relationships: The turret slide carriage supports the assembly; the SME20 module provides position feedback; the two connector assemblies carry services into the moving group; and the turret cover forms its neighboring guard.
annotations.inspection: Inspect the 12-station tool turret assembly for station faces, mounting interfaces, and nearby clearance. Look for visible interference, looseness, damage, or contamination.
annotations.safety: Before physical access, stop the machine and use the site’s authorized energy-control process. Follow the machine documentation for any service work.
